title: NO KINGS Guilford, CT
description:
**In America, we don’t put up with would-be kings.**
NO KINGS is a national day of action and mass mobilization in response to increasing authoritarian excesses and corruption from Trump and his allies. We’ve watched as they’ve cracked down on free speech, detained people for their political views, threatened to deport American citizens, and defied the courts. They’ve done this all while continuing to serve and enrich their billionaire allies.


🚨**On Saturday, June 14, we’re taking to the streets nationwide. We’re not gathering to feed his ego. We’re building a movement that leaves him behind.**🚨


The flag doesn’t belong to Donald Trump. It belongs to us. We’re not watching history happen. We’re making it.


**The Guilford Peace Alliance invites you to join us in a demonstration of a united Popular Front for a rules-based, just, inclusive American Democracy.
 
June 14, “No Kings Day” is actually Flag Day, and we will speak to the revolutionary moment when the flag was conceived as a declaration of democracy—1777. Then we’ll address the resurgence of the flag as an emblem of democracy for all following the Civil War. More, well learn from the courageous freedom fighters of the Civil Rights movement of the 1960s who carried the flag to declare their fervent hope that America would live up to its promise.
We, too, now reclaim the flag as We the People reject fascism & oligarchy and Fight to Restore Our Democracy NOW!
 
BRING FLAGS!  BRING SIGNS!
 
Let’s cover the Guilford Green with flags!

*A core principle behind all No Kings events is a commitment to nonviolent action. We expect all participants to seek to de-escalate any potential confrontation with those who disagree with our values.*

title: Protest Sign Making Party (Prep for 6/28 Protest)
description:
## Are you fed up with Texas legislators who don't represent Texans' best interests? So are we! Join us as we gear up for our protest outside of State Senator Angela Paxton's Office in Allen on 6/28!

## We're hosting our second monthly protest sign-making party at the Collin County Democratic Party HQ! Come ready to create bold, unapologetic messages that demand justice and change. This is about showing up, standing up, and being seen.

The TX lege just wrapped up one of its most harmful legislative sessions in state history, and the Republican majority in our legislature had a field day revoking Texans' rights. Here's a snapshot of what they "accomplished":

- school vouchers that take public tax dollars from public schools and give them to wealthy private school students and homeschoolers
- THC/marijuana ban
- extreme anti-abortion legislation
- book bans
- an attack on the separation of church and state; schools will now be required to post the Ten Commandments in classrooms

Bring your own poster board -we’ll have markers, paints, and supplies to help your message shine. Feel free to take home any signs you make to bring with you to the protest or donate them to CCDP to have extra signs to hand out to attendees!

title: Avelo Airline Nationwide Protest
description:
**Indivisible Mesa is joining the Coalition to Stop Avelo's nationwide call to action for a full boycott of Avelo Airlines and organizing protests at all 54 airports where they operate.** Our goal? Drive ticket sales to ZERO and make Avelo feel the consequences of profiting from deportations.

On May 31st, Indivisible Mesa was part of the **26 protests across the country** who came together to protest Avelo Airlines on the same day for the first time! To keep the pressure on Avelo, the Coalition is planning to support additional nationwide protests and Indivisible Mesa is again joining the call!!

**Indivisible Mesa will be protesting against Avelo Airlines operating ICE deportations on Saturday, June 28th!** 

By protesting together, everywhere, on the same day, we elevate our anti-Avelo movement from a local news story to a can't miss national news story!

🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨🚨

The message to **Avelo** is simple: **"Cancel your contract with ICE."**

The message to **City Hall** is simple: **"Stop funding Avelo with local dollars."**

The message to **travelers** is simple: **"Boycott Avelo, don't give them your money."**

The message to **allies** is simple: **"Join us. Stand for justice. Fight inhumanity."**

And the message to the **world** is powerful: 
*We stand for families. 
We stand for immigration rights. 
We stand for due process. 
We stand for all Americans who are feeling scared and vulnerable. 
We stand against companies that sacrifice people for profit. 
We stand against blood money and we stand against deals-with-the-devil. We stand against Avelo's contract with ICE. 
And we stand together, together, together. 
We will win this fight! 
We will force Avelo to cancel its ICE contract.**

Protest locally, speak nationally.

✨Be safe, be lawful, be loud. Bring signs. Bring friends. Take pics.✨


==**Protest Information**==

🌄 Indivisible Mesa will be at the intersection of East Ray Rd and Power Rd.

🅿️ There is PLENTY of parking in the store surrounding the intersection, including Walmart, Target, etc. 

❄️Bring all the things to keep yourself cool like cooling towels, umbrellas for shade, water, etc. and feel free to bring extra for other protestors if you are able to!

🔥Indivisible Mesa leadership realizes it may be too hot for some to attend the event, but we have to be outside and as visible as possible. IT'S VITAL. **If this means you can only protest for 20 mins, then please come for 20 mins!! Everybody and every minute counts!!**


==**Signs & Graphics**==
Please create signs and graphics that are relevant to Avelo & Mesa Gateway Airport! The messaging we put on our signs can do a lot to cut right through Mesa Gateway's bureaucratic smokescreen. 

   ☑️ Call attention to Avelo Airlines separating families

   ☑️ Complicity of Mesa/Gateway airport

   ☑️ Illegal deportations without due process

   ☑️ Human trafficking

   ☑️ Rather overheat than let human trafficking continue

   ☑️ Print out large pics of ICE kidnapping people in Phoenix

Please share and bring friends to protest against these flights that are illegal, inhumane, & unconstitutional.

## WHAT IS SENATE BILL 1?

- Senate Bill 1  (“The Higher Education Destruction Act”) was signed into OH law by Gov. DeWine on March 28, 2025 and goes into effect on June 25, 2025. 
- SB1 guts collective bargaining rights for faculty unions, removes job protections for educators & bans striking time for full-time staff.

- SB1 bans most diversity, equity & inclusion programs and staff training in higher education.
- We have until June 22 to collect 250,000 signatures in OH and get a repeal measure on the Nov. ballot.

title: Winston-Salem Screening of American Coup: Wilmington 1898
description:
We invite you to join Democracy North Carolina, The NAACP Winston-Salem Branch, Goler Memorial AME Zion Church Women’s Ministry, PBS North Carolina, and Working Films for a screening of *American Coup: Wilmington 1898* on **Friday, June 20th, from 5:30 PM to 7:30 PM**. 

**This in-person event will take place at Goler Memorial AME Zion Church (3894 Northampton Dr, Winston-Salem, NC 27105).**

The event will begin promptly at 5:30 PM with a light reception. The film screening will start at 6:00 PM, followed by a panel discussion, audience Q&A, and a closing prayer.

*American Coup: Wilmington 1898* is a documentary that tells the little-known story of a deadly race massacre and a carefully orchestrated insurrection in North Carolina’s largest city in 1898 — the only coup d’état in US history.

The film shares the story of how self-described white supremacists used intimidation and violence to destroy Black political and economic power and overthrow Wilmington’s democratically elected, multi-racial government. Black residents were murdered, and thousands were banished. The story of what happened in Wilmington was suppressed for decades until descendants and scholars began to investigate. Today, many of those descendants — Black and white — seek the truth about this intentionally buried history.

We hope you join us for this free screening and discussion to learn more about the massacre and coup, its place in US history, and its lasting impact. 

Together, we can ensure that the lessons of Wilmington’s past inform conversations around democracy today.

Questions? Contact Linda at linda@democracync.org.
